description: This file defines an Android activity 'PathFillTypes' which demonstrates different Path FillType modes (WINDING, EVEN_ODD, INVERSE_WINDING, INVERSE_EVEN_ODD) by drawing sample paths with various fill types on a Canvas. It includes a custom View ('SampleView') that performs the drawing in its 'onDraw' method.

classes.name: PathFillTypes
classes.description: Main activity that sets up the drawing demonstration for different Path fill types.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View subclass responsible for rendering sample paths with different fill types on the Canvas.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: showPath
methods.description: Draws a path with a specified fill type onto the canvas at a given position.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's onDraw to perform the demonstration drawing of paths with various fill types.
